blocks.orig: Canoe safaris are a great way to have fun and relax at the same time, while you experience nature from another perspective – from the water! In this activity, you take your canoe to the small crater lake of Lake Duluti, close to Arusha town. Surrounded by forest, you can spot eagles, kingfishers and darters in the hour-and-a-half that you glide over the tranquil water of this beautiful little lake.
blocks.html: A canoe safari lets you have fun and unwind at once, while seeing nature from a different angle – from the water! On this outing you paddle your canoe on Lake Duluti, a small crater lake near Arusha town. The lake is surrounded by forest, and during the hour and a half you glide across its calm water you can look out for eagles, kingfishers and darters on this lovely little lake.
